keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for November-December 1814, which Cliopatria lacks (its row starts in 1815): on 4 November 1814 the Storting 'adopted the constitutional amendments needed for the union and unanimously elected Charles XIII King of Norway'. Cliopatria's Swedish Empire and Kingdom of Norway rows both cover 1814 on the same ground, so the renderer should prefer this shape from November 1814.

804,282 km2 for 1815-1819: Sweden (2,429 of the modern 2,440 grid cells) and mainland Norway (1,721 of 2,004; the cells outside the shape are probably Svalbard and Jan Mayen, which the page does not mention), with a few border cells in Finland. The page gives no area, so there is no infobox comparison; Finland had been ceded to Russia in 1809 (Fredrikshamn) and is not in the union.
804,282 km2, identical to 1815-1819, for 1820-1899. The page records no border change in these eighty years (Karlstad 1905 is the first frontier text it gives).

804,282 km2 for 1900-1904. The union lasted into 1905: the Storting declared it dissolved on 7 June 1905, a plebiscite followed on 13 August, the Karlstad agreement on 23 September and Oscar II renounced the Norwegian crown on 26 October 1905. Cliopatria's Sweden and Norway rows (1905) draw the successors for 1905, so the union's last ten months are drawn as two states.

region.cliopatria: United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway
region.text: Sweden and mainland Norway, the two kingdoms of the union

ledger.note: 1814: the Storting elects Charles XIII King of Norway and the union with Sweden begins. 'On 4 November 1814 the Storting adopted the constitutional amendments needed for the union and unanimously elected Charles XIII King of Norway'; the Act of Union (Riksakten) was sanctioned on 15 August 1815.

region.text: Norway, entering the union on its own constitution

ledger.note: 1814: Norway comes under the Swedish crown. The Treaty of Kiel of 14 January 1814 ceded Norway to the King of Sweden, Norway's constitution of 17 May 1814 made it a kingdom of its own, the war ended with the Convention of Moss on 14 August 1814 and the Storting accepted the union on 4 November.

1905: Norway leaves the union. 'On 7 June 1905 the Storting unanimously declared the union dissolved, citing the king's refusal to form a new government'; a plebiscite on 13 August gave 368,392 votes for dissolution and 184 against.

region.text: Sweden, continuing as its own kingdom

ledger.note: 1905: the union ends. The Karlstad agreement of 23 September 1905 set up arbitration at The Hague, a neutral border zone and the demolition of Norwegian fortifications in it; on 26 October 1905, ten days after both parliaments revoked the Act of Union (16 October), 'King Oscar renounced all claims to the Norwegian crown'.

wars.name: Swedish-Norwegian War (1814)

zones.text: Norway, ceded to Sweden by the Treaty of Kiel but claiming independence

wars.outcome: The Swedish invasion of 29 July 1814 ended with the Convention of Moss on 14 August 1814, a general ceasefire based effectively on peace terms; the Storting accepted the union on 4 November 1814.
wars.note: The page gives the invasion date as 29 July (not 26 July) and names no front; the campaign is before this state's start, so no contest events are written here.

certainty.note: The union kept the earlier frontiers of the two kingdoms and Finland's loss to Russia (1809) fixed the eastern one; the page names no survey and dates only the 1905 neutral zone (Karlstad agreement). Treated as sharp on that basis.

notes:
Page budget 1 of 1-2 used (Union between Sweden and Norway); the page gives no area, so the 804,282 km2 could not be compared.
ROWS AND COUNTERPARTS. Cliopatria's Swedish Empire (1612-1814, Sweden only after 1809) and Kingdom of Norway (1814, 1905-2024) rows both cover 1814 on the same ground; kingdom-of-sweden and kingdom-of-norway restart in 1905. The union row 1815-1904 is the only Cliopatria row for Sweden and Norway in those years. Denmark-Norway (the previous owner of Norway) is dated 1814 onward by Cliopatria with a Denmark-only shape of about 185,000 km2.
START. The union began on 4 November 1814 (Storting election of Charles XIII); the Act of Union dates from 15 August 1815. The dossier starts in November 1814, one year before Cliopatria's first shape; a new keyframe covers 1814.
FINLAND. Not part of the union; ceded to Russia on 17 September 1809 (Fredrikshamn). The shape touches about 8 Finnish grid cells on the Norwegian-Swedish-Finnish frontier, a raster artefact.
Gaps: the Swedish-Norwegian war of 1814 is before the start and has no ledger contest events; the page names no zones. The frontier with Russia in Finnmark and the Sweden-Norway frontier treaties are not on the page.
